sentences.text: Shri Ashish Saxena, learned counsel for the applicant.
Mrs. Upendri Singh, learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent-State.

Counsel for the applicant seeks permission to withdraw the first bail application preferred under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C in connection with Crime No. 502/2019 registered at Police Station Jaura District Morena (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 272, 273 and 120-B of the IPC and Sections 51 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act with the liberty to file properly constituted bail application.
Accordingly, the same stands dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.

(S. A. DHARMADHIKARI) JUDGE Prachi PRACHI MISHRA 2019.09.04 16:14:28 +05'30'
